Lidia begins today's meal with a Creamy Risotto alla Milanese with Saffron and Marrow bone followed by a Succulent Quail Stuffed with Italian Sausage and Mushrooms. For dessert, it's an Italian classic - light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Berries.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Garlic and Onions appear in many Italian dishes, and in this episode they actually become the "star ingredients." Lidia starts the meal with a quick and easy Savory Onion tart followed by a delicious, mild and creamy Garlic Risotto. For dessert, it's all about chocolate with the moist Torta Caprese.
programme.sub-title: Garlic and Onion Steal the Show

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia prepares three regional Italian dishes- from Piedmont to Tuscany to Emilia Romagna. Her colorful Peppers Piedmontese are a great addition to any antipasto or buffet table, her Malfada Michelangelo Style is a delicious pasta dish based on dish attributed to Michelangelo. lastly, she shares a Filet Mignon Italian Style with Balsamic Reduction using this liquid gold from the area of Modena.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's a world famous technique but made with milk, it is famous only in the Italian region of Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table all year long, and she loves to plan a dinner that showcases the best and freshest of seafood. The menu is diverse today, as she prepares Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, a fun and elegant dish that is served with grilled bread; Cucumber Salad, a refreshing salad dressed with sweet honey, tangy vinegar and crunchy celery; and finally Baked Striped Bass with Lemon Sauce - made with cheese flavored breadcrumbs and baked to golden perfection.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today, Lidia shares three simply delicious Italian classics - a Shaved Fennel, Radish, Red onion and Prosciutto Cotto appetizer. Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini take the stage for her main course and a light Olive Oil Cake is a perfect finish to the meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians will wrap anything in dough, whether it's savory or sweet, and still have time for a classic. Lidia begins this meal with a savory Zucchini and Rice Crostata. She then turns to the sweets with a celebration of Zeppole, a fried delicious dough stuffed with creamy ricotta. Grandma Erminia, who has the sweet tooth in the family, joins Lidia for this segment.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves earthy, delicious mushrooms and today shares some of her favorite mushroom recipes that she has prepared over the years. She'll start with a Warm Mushroom Salad, a medley of warm wild mushrooms on a bed of frisee' topped with crispy pancetta and a poached egg. She'll also make Funghi Marinati, marinated button mushrooms in a flavorful mix of rosemary, orange and garlic; Her last dish is a hearty, flavorful and vegetarian Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

The menu includes: carrots and Apple Salad, Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble- a dessert that can be made with almost any fruit.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Calabria is famous for its fiery salami spread, 'Nduja. It is delicious on warm grilled bread, and Lidia shows viewers how to make a Bruschetta with 'Nduja; she then makes Raw and Cooked Salad for Summer with green beans and tomatoes, a wonderful way to enjoy seasonal vegetables.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today's episode features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets- from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about family in this episode as Lidia shares three of her favorite family recipes. Marinated Meatballs, Zucchini Parmigiana, Artichoke Carbonara and Jam Filler Mezzaluna are the stars of this episode.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians love their crespelle or crepes. In this episode, Lidia teaches viewers how to stuff them with tomato and grated cheese. Today's menu includes: Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad, "Crespelle Manicotti" stuffed with ricotta and mozzarella and for dessert, an Italian classic - beautiful Strawberries Topped with Balsamic Vinegar, a Lidia favorite.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fuzi with chicken ragu; no-bake chocolate ricotta brick cake.

programme.desc: Penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto; poached chicken and giardiniera salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves bringing people together in her kitchen, and she shares two recipes that are wonderful for a buffet-style meal, her favorite way of entertaining guests. She starts with a quick and easy Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini with a sauce of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, bread crumbs and parsley. Next on the menu is one of Lidia's favorite soups, Clam Soup, served with plenty of grilled bread on the side.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It doesn't get any better in an Italian kitchen than when Lidia makes fish and vegetables. In this episode, she prepares a nice and refreshing Pan Seared Shrimp with Arugula Pesto. Her next dish is Butterflied Trout, fried in a pan with Bacon and Basil served with a Zucchini Dish made with Anchovies and Capers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is all about feeding a large crowd, and Lidia cooks up recipes that all your guests will love, no matter whom you are hosting - Sausages and Apples, a flavorful one-pot meal that is great for family-style dining; Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Pesto, a delicious and economical addition to any party; and finally, Chocolate Ricotta Cheesecake, a chocolatey twist to the classic Italian ricotta cheesecake.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia constantly cherishes the memory of baking bread with her Grandma Rosa. As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Fettuccine with caramelized onions, bacon and olives; orange spritz; roast chicken with rosemary and lemon.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Grilled lamb chops are always delicious but n this episode, Ldiia sears them in a heavy skillet, pressing them down so that all the surface get crisp. She serves the chops with a simple yet elegant red wine sauce with dried cherries, garlic and bay leaves and rosemary. Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia believes in cooking according to season, and when springtime comes, she and her family all work well to create a beautiful garden. In this episode, she shares four delicious recipes that celebrate the bounty of the summertime garden. Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the balance today as Lidia pairs some unexpected ingredients that result in the best of flavors. She starts the meal with her Prosciutto and Fig Bruschetta: grilled bread topped with a salty sweet combination of prosciutto and fig jam; Spaghetti with Fennel and Bitter Greens: spaghetti tossed with fennel, escarole and a splash of balsamic; Chocolate Anise Biscotti: the "twice cooked" Italian cookie made with chocolate and anise.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: There is nothing like pasta to bring the Lidia's family to the table. In this episode Lidia shares some of her favorite pasta dishes including a comforting Baked Rigatoni with Zucchini , a delicious Penne with Ricotta and Mushrooms and one of her personal favorites, Fettuccine with a Clam and Leek Sauce.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Bergamot and ricotta parfait with nougatine and toasted almonds; almond tart; chocolate anise biscotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia introduces this episode with "Beautiful vegetables and a hot oven: a great marriage!" She then begins the meal with a simple and refreshing Sesame and Fava Bean Dip, perfect for flatbreads. Next, she prepares a Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables, topped with a golden, cheesy crust. Her unique version of Baked Potatoes is made with Pancetta and Oregano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Today is a celebration of some of Lidia's favorite comfort foods. The combination of potaoes and pasta in one dish is not unusual in Italy and in her Pippette with Sweet Potatoes, Lidia adds a beloved American ingredient to give it a nutritious and complex finish. Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves a good roast. It brings out unimaginable flavors, and the aromas from the kitchen will beckon your family to the table. Today's menu includes Red Onions Stuffed with Rice; a Roast Pork Shoulder with Roast Vegetable Sauce, and a brown sugar, bourbon and warm Baked Pineapple served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. She'll also show you how to prepare an easy dessert spread with seasonal fruits and a few store-bought sweet Italian specialties.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian cuisine is known for seasonal ingredients and simple techniques. In today's episode, Lidia will share recipes that master simplicity: Sausages with Fennel & Olives; Orange and Red Salad and a delicious "Almost a Tiramisu" recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As a young girl, from a small, rural setting, the majestic skyscrapers of Manhattan were quite the sight for Lidia. As a young teenager, Lidia was in charge of most dinners since her parents were returning home late in the evening, and soups were a popular choice to feed the family. In this episode, Lidia prepares a filling meal of Potato and Pasta Soup followed by Polenta with Honey and Berries, an easy way to use leftover polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Yellow saffron seafood and leek risotto; how to replenish stock using food scraps from the freezer; barley risotto with cabbage and sausage.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The egg is a staple ingredient in any kitchen and should not be overlooked or overcooked. In this episode, Lidia shows you the classic technique of poaching an egg and making a Warm Mushroom Salad: a bed of frisee with a warm medley of mixed wild mushrooms, pancetta and a poached egg; Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce: a simple and delicious tomato Sauce poached egg served with slices of grilled country bread and Brutti ma Buoni, a classic Italian hazelnut cookie made with meringue.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Tomatoes make the perfect canvas for any recipe, and in today's episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite dishes featuring this juicy, delicious staple of Italian cuisine. Her menu includes Eggs Poached in Tomato Sauce, served over easy on top of a crunchy slice of grilled country bread; Stuffed Tomatoes, filled with a classic combination of rice, mozzarella and basil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Pasta primavera "new school" with creamy pesto loaded with fresh vegetables; penne with vodka sauce; cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Halibut with saffron fregola; tuna and chickpea salad; shrimp alla Buonavia.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Celebrating the late-summer harvest with oat risotto with butternut squash and sunchokes; stuffed mushrooms; one-bowl olive oil cake and red wine poached pears.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a large pot of bubbling polenta, a dish that she grew up with and loved. From that polenta, she'll bake Crostini with Mixed Mushrooms and Cheese which is a perfect starter to any meal. Her granddaughter, Julia, joins her in the kitchen to help assemble and of course, taste! She'll then prepare a Hearty Polenta Dish with Bacon and Broccoli, a perfect combination. Finally, she'll make Sweet Skillet Sausage with Mixed Grapes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about freash seafood in this episode with three of Lidia's most requested fish recipes: Clam Brushetta features crusty Italian bread, still warm from the grill with clam sauce; Halibut Baked with Mushrooms in a Lemon and White Wine Sauce is a great weekend meal as is Grouper with Potatoes and Peppers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's all about the grill today since Italians love a "grigliata mista" or Italian grilled platters of meats, seafood and vegetables. Today, Lidia shares a menu that your guests will love as well. On the menu is Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis; Grilled Apple and Radicchio Salad with Gorgonzola and a flavorful Tuscan Maremma Style Steak.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: The oven is on in Lidia's kitchen, and she is using it for sweet and savory dishes. To start, she makes a springtime crunchy, Cheese Roasted Asparagus dish. Next is a family favorite, Baked Eggplant with Tomatoes, created with cheese, herbs and topped with a baked egg. Then it's time for sweets as she prepares an Almond Torte with Chocolate Chips served with a mound of whipped cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italians don't like to eat big pieces of meat, but they do like to braise small pieces with lots of vegetables into delicious ragus. In this episode, Lidia creates a delicious meal of Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; mouthwatering Lamb Ragu prepared with an array of peppers and potatoes and for a sweet finish, a Gianduia Cake made of hazelnuts and chocolate- a Piedmontese tradition.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Casseroles have a place in everyone's heart and home. Today Lidia shares a delicious and hearty Italian style version of Layered Casserole of Beef, Cabbage and Potatoes topped with fontina cheese - a one pot meal fit to feed any hungry crowd. Lidia then stews apples and dried fruit in her Spiced Fruit Compote and adds spices like clove and cinnamon - a heartwarming tea; Lastly, she is joined by Grandma for her Coffee Panna Cotta, an easy make-ahead dessert flavored with coffee and Sambuca.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Slow cooking does take a little time, but it is so rewarding! Today Lidia shares some classic techniques that will make show-stopping dishes for any occasion. Lidia prepares an elegant Risotto with Mushrooms, finished with parsley, cheese and butter. She'll then prepare a luscious Ziti with Pork Rib Guazzetto. Lidia then shows you how breathe new life into your risotto leftovers by breading it and frying it to make a delicious snack or serve it over a salad for a complete meal.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American classics are what Lidia discovered as a young 12 year old arriving in America. In this episode, she shares some of her favorites: Bolognese Sauce; Asparagus Salad and a lighter and more contemporary version of the Chicken Pizzaiola.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Summer is the time of year when some of Lidia's favorite vegetables and fruits are at their best. Today, she shares some recipes that she loves making at home when entertaining, including Corn and Zucchini Minestra; Shrimp and Mixed Bean Salad, a salad that is always part of the buffet table in Lidia's home; and lastly, Polenta with Honey and Berries, a recipe Lidia has loved since she was a little girl.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Orecchiette with breadcrumbs, pancetta, and cauliflower; crespelle with wild cherries, chocolate, and whipped cream; lemon ice.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Are you always in rush to prepare soemthing quick yet delicious for dinnertime? In this episode Lidia shares three of her favorite quick and simple meal ideas-all of which can work as an appetizer, a lunch or quick dinner. They include Scallops, Scallion and Mushrooms, Chicken Breasts with Orange and Gaeta Olives, Tuna with Mimosa Sauce

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian American cuisine has a unique history and continues to evolve with time. Lidia will demonstrate one of the traditional favorites - Spaghetti with Meatballs - before sharing a more contemporary Pork Chop Milanese that is a favorite in one of her restaurants.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says "Family Time " Pork and Grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu, she prepares Pork Medallions with grapes, Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Ornage in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian sweets are today's focus and include: Blueberry and Ricotta Parfait; Chocolate Zabaglione and Raspberry & Walnut Butter Cookies

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia loves long cooking techniques and braising but often, one just wants to prepare quick and delicious meals using the same technique. In this episode, she teaches the viewer to do just that. Her first dish is a velvety Lettuce Soup in a Fontina Gratin; she then makes a juicy but super quick Pork Tenderloin with Balsamic Onions. Lastly, she prepares String Beans with Rocky Mashed Potatoes made with garlic and olive oil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Crostini with fresh tomatoes and ricotta; warm crostini with smothered kale and melty fontina; monkfish brodetto with cannellini; garlic bread three ways.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: When Lidia was in her 20's, she opened Buonavia, her first restaurant, in Queens, New York. Her menu there included Italian American favorites, served alongside some of her favorite dishes from her homeland. In this episode, she prepares popular dishes from this first eatery including: a rich and flavorful Beef and Potato Goulash, and a sweet and simple Crespelle with Wild Cherries, Chocolate, and Whipped Cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia reminisces about her childhood chores, which included milking the goats and helping her grandmother prepare ricotta and other cheeses. In this episode, she will celebrate the culture of cheese and prepare the following recipes: Crostini Two Ways, using Tomato and Ricotta plus Kale and Fontina. Her next recipe is a hearty and cheesy dish of Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage and Mushrooms.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Southern Italian-style bruschetta; tomato and Tropea onion salad featuring crispy friselle bread; spicy bloody mary; panzerotti.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: As Lidia works in her garden, she reminisces about her childhood and of the lessons that Grandma Rosa taught her about her vegetable patch. In the kitchen, she makes a Country Salad as well as Green Beans with New Potatoes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: It's another episode dedicated to simplicity and delicious ingredients. Here Lidia chooses three great dishes that can be made in very little time but offer great flavors and complexity. They are great as appetizers, sides or by themselves and include Caprese Salad with Celery and Walnuts, Stuffed Artichokes with Tuna and Scallop Salad
programme.sub-title: Quick Light and Easy Meal Ideas

programme.title: We are Stronger
programme.desc: We Are Stronger is a faith-based film exploring a veteran's battle with PTSD. While Vic struggles to recover from his physical injuries, reclaim his marriage, and adjust to life after combat, he discovers he can't do it alone. Made in cooperation with the Stronger Alliance, Mighty Oaks, CRU Military, Amos House of Faith, Armed Forces Mission, and more who are dedicated to trauma recovery.

programme.title: Inheritance
programme.desc: When the family patriarch dies suddenly, the Delvecchio's are thrown into crisis. Family secrets and simmering feuds between brothers, fathers and sons threaten to undo the family until God intervenes.

programme.title: A Very Corgi Christmas
programme.desc: Laura, a single mom meets a fellow single dad Ben, who enlists her help in taking care of a cute corgi puppy he plans to give to his daughter at Christmas. Through all the chaos, Lauren gets the chance to finally experience the holiday spirit.

As thousands of terrified people are pulled into the maws of giant alien ships, Jarrod and his companions must use every skill they have to survive global genocide.

programme.title: Galaxy of Terror
programme.desc: Neurotic astronauts (Edward Albert, Erin Moran, Ray Walston) face a giant worm and other monsters on a distant planet.

programme.title: Eyes Without a Face
programme.desc: Dr. Génessier (Pierre Brasseur) is riddled with guilt after an accident that he caused disfigures the face of his daughter, the once beautiful Christiane (Edith Scob), who outsiders believe is dead. Dr. Génessier, along with accomplice and laboratory assistant Louise (Alida Valli), kidnaps young women and brings them to the Génessier mansion. After rendering his victims unconscious, Dr. Génessier removes their faces and attempts to graft them on to Christiane's.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Deathstalker II
programme.desc: Hero Deathstalker (John Terlesky) helps Princess Evie (Monique Gabrielle) reclaim her throne from a sorcerer (John La Zar) and his Princess Evie clone.

programme.title: Among Wolves
programme.desc: Two missionaries witness a murder by hired guns and go on the run. They stumble onto the cabin of two retired contract killers who agree to help the women find safety, but only their guns can secure that promise.

programme.title: Down in the Valley
programme.desc: On a trip to the beach, a teenage girl named Tobe meets a charismatic stranger named Harlan, who dresses like a cowboy and claims to be a former ranch hand. The pair feel an instant attraction and begin a relationship, but her father, a lawman, is suspicious of her lover.

programme.title: Basmati Blues
programme.desc: When a young scientist learns she has unwittingly aided a destructive plan against the Indian farmers she was supposedly sent to help, she teams up with a local farmer to save the day.

programme.title: Breakfast of Champions
programme.desc: An unhappy car dealer (Bruce Willis) believes that a dime-store author/philosopher (Albert Finney) has the answers to life's important questions.

programme.title: Shade
programme.desc: Tiffany (Jamie Foxx), Charlie (Gabriel Byrne) and Vernon (Thandie Newton) are con artists looking to up the ante from their typical scams. They figure a good way of doing this is taking down Dean "The Dean" Stevens (Dina Merrill), a well-known cardsharp, in a rigged game. However, they first need enough money to enter a game with Stevens, so they decide to strike a deal with fellow crook Larry Jennings (Stuart Townsend) to scam a local gangster -- which turns out to be a bad idea.

programme.title: The Crush
programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.title: Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas
programme.desc: Emmet and Ma Otter are very poor, but they are very happy and talented singers. Christmas is around the corner, and they both want to get the other a very special present. The prize in the talent show is $50. Both Emmet and Ma get a song ready for the competition; Emmet forms a jug band, and Ma practices alone, to vie with the Riverbottom Gang.

The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: Timecop [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: When mankind perfects time travel, the government establishes the Time Enforcement Commission to thwart criminal attempts to alter the timeline. Police officer Walker (Jean-Claude Van Damme) is recruited by TEC Cmdr. Matuzak (Bruce McGill), but soon finds his investigation of Senator Aaron McComb (Ron Silver) being thwarted by elements within the government. When Walker's wife, Melissa (Mia Sara), is attacked, he must travel across time to rescue her and save the future.

programme.title: Wind and Bone
programme.desc: A woman on the run joins a group of college students in rural West Virginia, where they soon encounter the Wendigo.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: I'm Beginning to See the Light
programme.desc: After losing his family in a brutal accident, ex-trumpeter Ezra finds solace as a lighthouse keeper. But when two visitors reveal their true motives, Ezra must decide: let the light back into his life or stay in the shadows.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Donovan's Echo
programme.desc: When a series of uncanny deja vu events begin to occur, a man must re-examine his tragic past and instinct.

programme.title: 10.5 Apocalypse
programme.desc: The aftershocks of a massive West Coast quake devastate the country state-by-state culminating in a possible nuclear meltdown.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: A Great Divide
programme.desc: The Lee family leave the Bay Area for a fresh start in the rural expanses of Wyoming, only to encounter hostility and xenophobia in their new community. How they confront these issues will break them - or make them stronger.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: McCrae and Wood's cattle drive faces deadly situations. Sheriff July Johnson heads to Texas, and former prostitute Lorena is abandoned by Jake and kidnapped by the psychotic Blue Duck.

programme.title: Shiver Me Timbers
programme.desc: In Northern California during the summer of 1986, Olive Oyl, along with her cinema-obsessed friends and brother Castor, embark on a once-in-a-lifetime camping trip to witness the dazzling meteor shower accompanying the arrival of Halley's comet. But what starts as a serene evening of stargazing quickly turns into a harrowing nightmare when a meteor from the comet transforms Popeye, into a terrifying and unstoppable killing machine.

programme.title: Desert Fiends
programme.desc: Six friends on their way to a concert break down in the middle of nowhere and encounter a deranged family that lives in the desert killing anyone they come across.

programme.title: Crawdaddy
programme.desc: Amid the pandemic, Gwynn grows bored with her relationship with Adam. A sex dream involving their friend Lance ignites fantasies, transforming her COVID bubble into a chaotic love triangle.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Quincy, Massachusetts to investigate the unexplainable paranormal events that are haunting a 716 foot long ship. The USS Salem spent decades sailing the oceans of the world as a witness to untold death and damage. In 1953, a large earthquake struck the Ionian Islands in Greece, completely devastating the communities and killing hundreds. The USS Salem was the first American ship to arrive on the scene and provided relief supplies and assistance.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS is called in to investigate the Fort Henry, where it once served as a cornerstone for Canada's military defense and execution site. Today, Fort Henry is considered by many to be the most haunted place in Canada. One frequently reported incident involves a male apparition seen wandering around the exterior and interiors of the fortress.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Chicago Illinois to investigate a Chicago landmark for nearly a century, the Congress Theater. Built in 1926, the massive building's original Italian Renaissance architecture remains mostly preserved. The Congress has transitioned through the decades of Chicago history and exists today as a renowned live concert venue. According to many present and past employees, there is also something undeniably paranormal present at the theater.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week TAPS answers the Wrights begging call heads to Manitou Springs, Colorado to investigate the Briarhurst Manor located at the base of Pike's Peak. The property was built in 1888 by Englishman William Bell and has had about 20 owners throughout the years. The property was made into apartment buildings in the early 70's and then became a restaurant now owned by Ken Healey. One of the prior owners Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team has been called to wrangle some ghosts that seem to be haunting the resting place of Buffalo Bill. The museum staff has asked the TAPS team to help them figure out if the old cowboy has made this site his final rest stop. Cody died in Denver in 1917 and his final request was to be buried on Lookout Mountain with views of the mountains and plains where he spent most of his life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: The TAPS team heads to New Hampshire to help a group of volunteers figure out what is causing the lively paranormal activity in their otherwise quiet museum. The Amos J. Blake House was originally built in 1837 as a commercial building that was used for both business and to house tenants. Several deaths have occurred in the house, mostly children, before the turn of the 20th century. Amos J. Blake moved into the house with his wife Lizzie in the 1860's.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to the Florida Panhandle to investigate a notoriously haunted lighthouse with over a century's worth of paranormal reports. Located on the Pensacola Naval Air Station, home of the Blue Angels, the Lighthouse stands 160 feet above Pensacola Bay and the Florida Gulf Coast. The beacon ranges in diameter from 30 feet at the base to 15 feet at the top and is total of 177 steps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called to the former home of one of the world's most famous authors in order to investigate a series of startling paranormal occurrences. Mark Twain and his family occupied this architecturally unique house for nearly 20 years. After his daughter died in the home, Twain and his family abandoned the property. Today, the curators of the house are plagued with an array of strange sights and sounds.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: This week, TAPS takes a call from the American Legion in Pennsylvania where people are terrified by paranormals. The building was established in the 1700s and was once rented out as apartments. The current owners have had the property since 1974 and are convinced that the place is haunted, so TAPS heads in to find out. Jason and Grant begin the hunt on the third floor where the current owner says she's too afraid to go.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: In the exciting season finale, TAPS travels to the site where Hindenburg, one of history's most infamous disasters, took place. The Hindenburg was a German airship filled with hydrogen for buoyancy. In 1937, while trying to dock at the Lakehurst Naval base, it caught fire and killed 36 people. The entire ordeal was caught on film and is still one of the most famous tragedies that have ever been reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For the 100th episode of Ghost Hunters, the team is allowed private access to Alcatraz Island, a dream come true for paranormal teams. From a two day prison revolt in 1946 known as the Battle of Alcatraz that occurred, people say they can still hear gun fire and crying. In Cell Block D, otherwise known as solitary confinement, there is a report of a run in with a spirit. Other activity reported is that of an apparition of a prisoner with glaring red eyes, and the sound of screams.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Fort Ticonderoga, located in upstate New York, is being haunted by the dead from three nations and needs help from the TAPS team. The fort was built in 1755 by the French army, and would be witness to several bloody battles over the next two decades. The British army suffered 2,000 casualties; it was the most devastating battle on American soil until the Civil War. Due largely to the amount of violence and death that took place, there is lots of paranormal activity reported.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team has been asked to go to Paddy Reilly's Bar in Manhattan, New York to help explain some after hours activity. Dark shadows have been seen in the basement, voices have been heard, glasses are known to move on their own, and bottles break for no apparent reason. In an upstairs apartment, three men saw an apparition riding a bike, and across the hall a tenant saw a man resembling Gene Hackman peering through a window.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team visits the Absecon Lighthouse in Atlantic City, NJ. This lighthouse has activity reported ranging from untraceable footsteps and doors opening spontaneously, to coughing coming from the keeper's quarters. In the lighthouse itself, people have reported smelling cigar smoke, hearing voices and laughter, and even seeing a persons hand.Jason and Grant start out in the tower, where they hear a possible conversation and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to The Southern Mansion in Cape May, NJ, and have enlisted the help of Dave Tango's father, Bruce. Bruce has experienced first hand some of the reported activity here; some of it includes glasses dissolving into sand, people being grabbed, a soldier walking through walls, a soldier talking with a woman, and the smell of gardenias. It is believed that the ghost woman could possibly be the niece of the original owner, Esther.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters the TAPS team investigates Preston Castle, a once notorious reform school for boys in Northern California. People have seen apparitions of a man in a white coat in the doctor's office. The infirmary seems to be haunted by a boy that was shot while trying to escape the school. Upstairs there are claims of humming noises, groups of voices, a mist and a woman who claims she was pinched on the butt.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been called to the Grzelak house in Massachusetts where they have been experiencing paranormal activity since the day they moved in 30 years ago. A series of apparitions, shadow people, mysterious voices and even physical attacks have left the Grzelaks desperate for help, to the point where they want to move.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called to Cape Cod to investigate the Orleans Inn. Some of the claims here are that candles light on their own, glasses slide off tables, hauntings by two separate men who hung themselves, doors opening and closing, and ghosts of naked women. Despite all this, the strangest claim comes from Room 5, where two separate guests have checked in and been driven to insanity inside the room.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the home of the Scully family, who are so terrified they are ready to pack up and move. Some of the activities reported in the house are confrontational shadows, spirits breathing down people's necks and, adult legs walking up the stairs. The greatest activity is in the 4-year-old son's bedroom, where he spends his time with the spirits of 2 small children, and talks to them as well as about them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to be invited to investigate Norwich State Hospital, in Norwich, Connecticut. There have been lots of rumors of activity, including moving shadows, haunting faces, screams, moans, and apparitions of children. Excited to start investigating, Jason and Grant start out in the research building and right away they see a moving shadow followed by a strange noise, and faint light in the stairway.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS drives to the Otesaga Resort Hotel in Cooperstown, NY. Employees are terrified by voices calling out to them and doors swinging all on their own. Guests in the hotel also hear non-existent children running the halls and furniture being dragged across the floor upstairs (even on the top floor), while shadows and orbs have been seen and moaning has been heard. Jason and Grant start out in the ballroom, and try to debunk the claim of an orb.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS has been asked to help the 1875 Inn in Tilton, New Hampshire. The Inn has had two major fires, one of which supposedly took the life of a child named Laura, who now haunts the hotel. One claim is that about 30 people saw a gargoyle-like creature suspended in the air. Another claim is hair being stroked, and there are numerous "Laura" encounters.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS visits the location of the "shot heard round the world" at the Colonial Inn in Concord, Massachusetts. Some of the reported activity includes shadowy figures, people being touched, objects flying off the shelf, and power surges. The history goes all the way back to 1775, when wounded soldiers from the Battle of Concord were brought to the site for medical attention.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is on Rose Island to investigate their haunted lighthouse. This island housed cholera victims exiled from Newport, and many of the sick never returned to the mainland. From inside the quarantine room of the barracks, people have heard voices or felt uneasy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate the abandoned Milton School in Alton, Ill. where some students are said to still be walking through the halls. In the 1930's a young student named Mary was killed at the school, and the janitor who was the prime suspect then committed suicide inside the building. There are claims that people feel a child holding their hand and smell bubble gum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there. The house's history is checkered; for starters, it was built on top of where an insane asylum once stood. Seven women died - a man killed his wife and then himself. Lights turn themselves on and off, people have seen apparitions and heard footsteps, and a clock spontaneously comes to life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist. The Bissman Building has been in his family for five generations, and has its fair share of paranormal activity. Many believe the activity started in 1911 following a violent death where an employee was decapitated by the building's elevator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Haunt Is

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team. Before the team heads out, we learn that Kris and Britt will be joining the GHI team and heading to Eastern Europe. The fort was built in 1755. During the French and Indian War, local Native American tribes defeated the British, killing over 1,000 people.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions and shadow figures to footsteps and conversations. A braid of hair and shoe were also found in the basement during renovations.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. Some believe the Opera House's builder Charles Sterling haunts it, because he died two years before the building was complete.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team travels to New Castle, Pennsylvania to investigate Hill View Manor. programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Townsend, Massachusetts to investigate the Townsend Historical Society's two houses; the Reed Homestead and the Spaulding Cooperage. The main goal is to help staff not be afraid of paranormal activity that seems to be taking place at both properties. Built in 1809, the Reed Homestead was home to four generations of the Oliver Reed family. One of Oliver Reed's four daughters, Hannah, hanged herself after the death of her young daughter.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the Carnegie Library Homestead, in Homestead, Pennsylvania. This Library was the site of violent riots between Carnegie and the steel workers. It is said that Carnegie built the library to win the steel workers over. It is thought that steel workers or Carnegie himself could be haunting the building. Some of the reported activity includes shadow figures, books falling off shelves, apparitions, and voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen

programme.title: Ciao Italia - Classic Pasta of Liguria
programme.desc: Food writer and book author Laura Schenone brings a unique Ligurian recipe to Mary Ann's kitchen, where together they prepare delicate pasta wafers called Corzetti served in a delicate garlic and olive oil sauce. Mary Ann adds to the fun with Panzoti, an almond-stuffed little ravioli swimming in a butter sauce. Bravissima Laura e Marianna, e bravissima Liguria!

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The CentralTirgus is the biggest covered city food market in Europe. Just aside the Art Nouveau Old Town, we find century-old rye-bread making, grilled lampreys, soviet milk sausages, and hemp butter. Here the best of Latvian traditions are pushed fast-forward into the digital era by young and curious chefs, bloggers, and pop-up restaurants.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Riga

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The old ladies selling their baskets full of vegetables and cheese on the Dolac market in Zagreb bring us back in time. At the market, we go from the breathtaking Mediterranean islands to the Austrian Alps, from freshly caught hake and simple Baltic snacks to internationally awarded cheese and a unique Turkey breed.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Zagreb

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: At the Mercato Centrale in San Lorenzo, one can taste the best food treasures Tuscany has on offer: from the olive oil of the Fiesole hills to the onions of the medieval borough of Certaldo and up to the Natural Reserve of San Marcello with its Tuscan cured meats. Here the simple and genuine tastes are king.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Firenze

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Viktualienmarkt developed from an original farmers' market to a popular market for gourmets. The market also hosts a number of traditional and folkloric events. But the center of the social life of the city is the world-famous Biergarten - here the seven historical breweries of the city pour the finest beers of the world.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Munich

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Ireland's third-largest city has one of Northern Europe's market gems: The English Market. It supplies high-quality food to affluent English families unlike the Irish market, which no longer exists. The best Irish produce today remains on the island and can be found here.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Cork

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: The Kapani market is situated just behind the Aristotelous square of the city of Thessaloniki, facing the Aegean Sea. Exploring this market is exploring the city and its history: a tasteful mix of Sephardic, Balkan, Turkish, and Greek delights. All can be found in the intricate streets of the market or tasted at the many cafés and tavernas operating there daily.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Thessaloniki

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores medieval English taverns, inns, and alehouses, each serving different roles and social classes. Taverns sold wine, inns provided lodging, and alehouses were private homes selling ale. The episode covers wine quality control, bread and ale laws, and their reputations for gambling and excess. He recreates bokenade, a beef pottage with saffron, cloves, and verjuice.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What it was like to visit a Medieval Tavern

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the Old West saloon as a social hub for food and drink. He covers its evolving design, popular beverages like whiskey, beer, champagne, and cocktails, gambling games such as poker, and the famous "free lunch" tradition. The episode highlights regional foods, oysters' popularity, and recreates an 1886 pork and beans recipe from *Cooking for Profit*.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Food was Served at Wild West Saloons?

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores WWII home front rationing in the U.S., from 1942 sugar limits to the red and blue point system for meat, dairy, and canned goods. He covers price controls, Victory Gardens, labor shortages, internment camps, and black-market "meatleggers." He also recreates Betty Crocker's "emergency steak," a budget-friendly mix of ground beef, cereal, and milk.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Cooking on the American Home Front During WWII

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's luxurious first class, from modest suites to lavish parlor suites with private promenades. He covers dining in the saloon and Ritz, daily meals, amenities like the gym and Turkish bath, and the 10+ course final dinner. Using survivor accounts, he recreates the famous peaches in Chartreuse jelly dessert from April 14, 1912.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Dining First Class on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores Titanic's first class breakfast from April 11, 1912, featuring over a dozen dishes by Escoffier. He recreates baked apples, smoked salmon coronets, shirred eggs, and buckwheat cakes with blackcurrant conserve. The episode highlights dining venues, passenger pets, and the tragic story of honeymooners Victor and Maria Josefa Peñasco.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - First Class Breakfast on the RMS Titanic

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores the 4-6 month, 2,200-mile Oregon Trail journey (1846-1869), covering provisions like flour, bacon, and hardtack, cooking over buffalo chips, and staple meals like Johnny cakes. He discusses hunting, trading with Native Americans, celebrations, and hardships, including spoiled food, salt-rising bread, pies, and pioneers leaving possessions at Fort Laramie.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - What Pioneers ate on the Oregon Trail

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Ötzi the Iceman's last meal (c. 3,359-3,105BC), discovered in 1991. He covers Ötzi's clothing, tools, health (tattoos, heart disease, parasites), and likely murder by arrow. Using stomach contents-smoked ibex, charred red deer, and einkorn pancake with fiddle ferns-Max cooks over an open fire to mimic Neolithic methods.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Recreating the Last Meal of Ötzi the Iceman

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max traces airline food from 1919's first commercial meal to aviation's Golden Age (1950s-70s). He covers flight kitchens, cold-to-hot meal evolution, themed flights, flight attendant hiring, the 1958 Great Sandwich War, and 1978 deregulation. Max recreates a 1954 United Airlines meal of pot roast, vegetables, Delmonico potatoes, and marshmallow-apple salad.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Airline Food During the Golden Age of Air Travel

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max recreates Medieval Irish corned beef and cabbage from *The Vision of Mac Con Glinne* (c. 1100) with onion-leek pottage. He explores Ireland's rigid food hierarchy-peasants ate grains and salted meat, butter signified wealth, monks preferred game, nobles had fresh meat-and cultural practices like fosterage, the 7-year child-rearing system, and a satirical poem about King Cathal's gluttony.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Medieval Irish Food: Peasant to King

programme.title: Tasting History with Max Miller
programme.desc: Max explores lighthouse keeper life via an 1881 provisioning list and period recipes. He covers the isolated, demanding job-cleaning Fresnel lenses with mercury, trimming wicks, and cooking with limited supplies like flour, beans, and salt pork. Featuring keepers Henry Long, Mary Ryan, and Hannah Thomas, he recreates Fannie Farmer's 1896 Boston corn chowder with pilot bread.
programme.sub-title: Tasting History with Max Miller - Eating like a Lighthouse Keeper from the 1800's

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann teaches her Scuola Culinaria student, Karen the traditional Italian culinary secrets of creating soft-as-a-cloud, pillowy gnocchi every time. When they're as perfect as these Amalfi-style gnocchi, all that's needed is a buttery, heavy cream sauce of asparagus tips and lemon zest to make you close your eyes, take one taste and swear you're in Amalfi.
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Got Lemons, Make Gnocchi

programme.title: Ciao Italia

Then she makes another favorite, Meatballs Milan Style. Stuffed with filled with mortadella, beef, and ham and fried to a crunchy crisp, you'll want seconds, thirds, fourths!
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Gaetano's Easy Chicken Casserole

programme.title: Ciao Italia
programme.desc: Mary Ann and eager Scuola Culinaria student John roll up their sleeves and dive into the essential steps need to create an all-time favorite of favorites, Pizza Margherita. Step by step, sauce by sauce, cheese by cheese learn how to take your pizza all the way from yeast to "Yay!" And they're not done yet, not until they make Fried Dough with Cinnamon and Sugar from yeast to "Yum!"
programme.sub-title: Ciao Italia - Make Pizza with a Friend

programme.title: Ciao Italia

Mary Ann's up next with her signature Broccolini and Artichoke Pesto tossed with Fusilli. Want perfect pesto every time? Try either one-or both!

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia heads to South Carolina to meet the many talented artisans that define Lowcountry. From a basket weaver who is keeping the sweetgrass tradition of the Gullah Geechee people alive, to an intercoastal inspired shrimp recipe served in ironware crafted right down the street. Find out why the Lowcountry is defined by its character as much as it is a spot on the map.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Heritage of the Lowcountry

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to a festival in the Ozarks where she is teaching a cooking class. We follow her as she prepares and gathers her ingredients - we meet a small town chicken farmer, gather produce at the local farmers market, and set the table at a local textile studio where Georgia learns to dye napkins.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Discover Your Roots

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Join Georgia on an urban foraging expedition and learn from an edible and medicinal plants expert as he and Georgia collect a variety of items during a walk through the neighborhood. From flower studded ice cubes, to honeysuckle tea, to dandelion green salad, Georgia is making the most of what is around her.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Into the Wild

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Women from around the country convene in west Texas for a transformative experience in the wild. During the episode, Georgia teaches viewers about the different cuts of venison and the ways to cook them, as well as how to save money by grinding your own meat. The guests and viewers will leave feeling empowered and with a different perspective on what it is to be a human and an omnivore.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Go West, Young Woman

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia hosts a dinner party at her home in Austin, Texas, focusing on ingredients that are as locally sourced and homemade as possible. Pulling produce from her own garden, she turns it into pickled vegetables, tomato bread salad, a lemon balm cocktail and more! Georgia even decorates the dinner table entirely with items she has found in nature.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Entertaining at Home

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels back to the South of France, where she once cooked at a Michelin restaurant, and spends time in the olive harvest with a family who is carrying on the tradition of making olive oil. We learn about the herbs that are grown by a farmer late in the season to be infused in the olive oil, and how the oil is used by the baker who is baking bread using heirloom wheat.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - France: The Noble Olive

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia travels to the Rosebud Native American Reservation in South Dakota and spends time with the Lakota people who are pursuing the "7-generation framework" - their vision for the next 150 years. She learns about the work they are doing to reclaim their food sovereignty, their culture and language, to bring their people back to that sacred place of equilibrium that is essential in building a strong and sovereign tribal nation - where they are physically, spiritually, and mentally whole.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Lakota Nation: A Story of Empowerment

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini
programme.desc: Georgia visits the Catskills in New York, where a couple has created a stunning homestead and serves their community through weekly dinners that now attract people from afar. She heads out into the woods, into the root cellar, and into the kitchen with Jake and Elizabeth as they create a beautiful meal for dinner guests. The couple shares how they created this space and offer inspiring ideas for living and entertaining.
programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - The Bovina Farm and Fermentory Story

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini

programme.sub-title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - From Earth to Art

She tastes onion pie, delicious cured pork, and one of the oldest cheeses in the world, kopanisti, still made on the island. In the kitchen, she makes a garlicky local pasta recipe, and a traditional Greek island fish soup.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Food Secrets Of Mykonos

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Gorgeous cafes, bustling nightlife, yachting and water sports, just 20 minutes south of the Greek capital, Athens. Diane visits a fish market where the catch is right off the boat, sails the coast, and returns to her kitchen to create three delicious, contemporary Greek recipes, inspired by the cosmopolitan bustle and fun-loving spirit of the Athenian coast.

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas

The flavors of historic Chios inspire her to cook up a succulent chicken and quince dish and an easy traditional black eyed pea salad with Mastiha vinaigrette.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tasty Teardrops And Tomatoes: Chios

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Naxos is famed for the quality of its meats, its array of cow's milk and sheep-and-goats' milk cheeses and for its potatoes. Diane heads from the shore straight to a remote mountain hideaway with Alexis in tow, where two local cooks await them with a feast of stuffed lamb, potatoes, and a unique skillet pumpkin-onion pie.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Naxos: Meat & Potatoes Like You Never Had'em

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Near the historic Bay of Navarino, blanketed by olive, citrus trees and home to historical culinary artifacts unearthed in prehistoric clay tablets at Pylos, Diane cooks with two village ladies, making a local pork and fig dish, and olive-oil fried bread. programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - A Meal In Messinia

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: The second-largest Greek island and an hour from Athens, Diane heads out in search of mushrooms with a local mushroom forager and cultivator. Diane makes three delectable dishes with mushrooms, wine and local ingrediants, inspired by the flavors of this nearby "secret" land.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Evia - An Island Hiding In Plain Sight

programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Barcelona: Gaudi, Gin And Gambas

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals

Back at home, Sara uses canned sardines for a quick and easy pantry taco.

If you start to lick the screen don't panic...
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Turin

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: An enchanting city, Barcelona is brimming with inspirations left by the greatest of artists. But this charming city has another jewel in its crown - La Boqueria food market. Take a journey through the senses with our lively characters and uncover their gastronomic secrets.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Barcelona

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Arriving by boat to the Baltic Sea Harbor of Helsinki, it is the first building you see. Behind it, the square and the great dome of the city hall. The Old Market Hall (Wanha VanhaKauppahall) is a beautiful little 19th-century brick building with hi-varnish wooden stalls.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Helsinki

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets
programme.desc: Placed in the middle of Palermo's ancient streets, it is almost difficult to walk. All around there is a swarm of colors and perfumes. There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo
